svg.text: A CLAN EVENT FOR THE SPOOKIEST SEASON
MORYTANIA NIGHTS, CURSED LOOT, AND CONTROLLED CHAOS

The Crypt Keeper: Complete 50 Barrows chests
Grave Robber: Obtain a Skull sceptre from the Stronghold of Security.
Spooky Wardrobe: Complete the Halloween Holiday Event, or equip 1 full Skeleton outfit and earn 1 qualifying drop.
The Exorcist: Complete one requirement
FREE SPACE: BOO!
Arachnophobia: Defeat Sarachnis and obtain 1 Sarachnis cudgel
The Undertaker: Cremate 25 shades in Mort'ton, or burn 25 Chewed bones to send their spirits onward.
Revenant Hunter: Obtain 1 Ancient Emblem, 1 Ancient Totem, or 1 Ancient Statuette from the Revenants.
Bone Collector: Offer 100 dragon bones or better at the Chaos Altar.
Shades of Mort'ton: Open a Gold Shade Chest using a gold key in the creepy, infected town of Morytania.

text.tspan: using a gold key in the

g.title: The Grim Reaper: Teleport to Death's Office and successfully claim a Grave / Death reclaim while wearing a black cape.
Fists of Fury: As a team, complete 10 Barrows chests with no equipped weapons. Barrows damage may come from spells, prayers, or fists.
Ghostbusters: Complete a team Wilderness boss trip with every participant wearing at least one Ghostly robe piece.
The Witching Hour: Award a bonus point for a unique or pet received between 12:00 AM and 1:00 AM local time. Record the game clock and screenshot.

text.tspan: - Award a bonus point for a

g.title: Zombie Apocalypse: Win a Pest Control game while every participant wears a zombie-themed outfit, or complete a raid room with everyone poisoned at the finish.
Spooky Scary Skeletons: Complete a Barrows chest or raid room while every participant wears a visible skeleton-themed item.
The Necromancer: Defeat a Wilderness boss while every participant uses the Arceuus spellbook and summons a thrall during the kill.
